🔥 reel-generator | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate beat-synced video reels from raw video clips and a song, simplifying the video editing process for social media.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic beat-synced reel generation • Intelligent moment selection from long videos • Handles various phone media formats (HEIC, HDR) • Multiple editing styles (Hype, Smooth, Cinematic) • Audio sourcing from YouTube links or uploads
📖 Summary: Reel Maker is a Python-based tool that automatically creates Instagram Reels by analyzing video clips and music to sync cuts to the beat. It processes raw phone media, identifies key moments, and applies different editing styles without manual trimming or AI.
